$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure API Management. See aws/s3.json for the contract.

azure.apim.service.crud.title: API Management services (create, get, list, delete) over ARM

azure.apim.service.protocols.title: Protocol settings / Protocols + ciphers (properties.customProperties)
limitations: TLS/SSL protocol and cipher flags round-trip through ARM exactly as configured, but Vyomi's gateway never negotiates TLS, so disabling a protocol here has no effect on anything.

azure.apim.apis.crud.title: APIs (create, get, list, delete) — a real ARM sub-resource of the service

azure.apim.apis.createflows.title: Creating an API from WebSocket, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI, WSDL, WADL, or an Azure resource (API App / Function App / Container App / Logic App); restricting a new API to specific gateways
limitations: HTTP, WebSocket, GraphQL and gRPC are modeled (display name, name, backend URL, API URL suffix, description, product — properties.apiType round-trips through ARM exactly like real APIM). Importing from a definition file (OpenAPI/WSDL/WADL) or an Azure resource (API App/Function App/Container App/Logic App), and per-API gateway restriction, are not simulated — new APIs are always reachable on the managed gateway.

azure.apim.products.crud.title: Products (create, get, list, delete) and product↔API association — real ARM sub-resources of the service
limitations: The "Visibility" column (developer-portal group association) is not modeled; products always show no visibility groups.

azure.apim.subscriptions.crud.title: Subscriptions (create, get, list, delete) — a real ARM sub-resource of the service
limitations: Primary/secondary keys are simulator-generated tokens, not real signing keys; the Owner column is not modeled (no AAD identity is attached to a subscription).

azure.apim.namedvalues.crud.title: Named values, Plain and Secret (create, get, list, delete) — a real ARM sub-resource of the service

azure.apim.namedvalues.keyvaultref.title: Named values of type Key Vault
limitations: The secret identifier only resolves against a Key Vault secret created in this SAME Vyomi space (the simulator's one Key Vault secrets store) — it can't reach an external vault, same as every other cross-service reference in Vyomi.

azure.apim.backends.crud.title: Backends (create, get, list, delete) — a real ARM sub-resource of the service

azure.apim.locks.title: Resource locks (Microsoft.Authorization/locks), scoped to the service
limitations: Locks are only simulated at the resource scope (this service); subscription- and resource-group-scoped lock lists are an honest 'Not simulated' gap, same as the real Subscription/Resource group scope-switch buttons.

azure.apim.activity_log.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill); severity/category filtering is not modeled, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than the real signed-in principal. The timespan picker IS enforced — it maps to a real `eventTimestamp ge/le` $filter.

azure.apim.iam.title: Access control (IAM) on a service: role assignments and built-in role definitions over ARM
limitations: Role assignments and role definitions are real ARM resources (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments, roleDefinitions). The Role assignments list IS scoped to this one service (plus its subscription/resource-group ancestors, matching real inherited access) — but 'Check access' / 'My access' evaluation, Deny assignments and Classic administrators are not modeled, and Vyomi never denies a console action based on a role assignment.

azure.apim.developerportal.title: Developer portal (overview, settings, Users, Groups, Identities, Delegation)
limitations: The developer portal CMS, its user/group/identity-provider directory, and delegation are not modeled.

azure.apim.diagnosticsettings.title: Diagnostic settings (Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings, scoped to this service)
limitations: Logs/metrics are never actually delivered to the configured destination (workspace, storage account or event hub) — there is no agent/telemetry pipeline, so the setting is stored and validated exactly as the real resource requires but nothing flows.

Vyomi has no catalog of APIM's real log/metric category names (GET .../diagnosticSettingsCategories is not modeled) — the create form offers the 'allLogs' category group and 'AllMetrics' rather than APIM's specific category picker.

azure.apim.monitoring.title: Application Insights, Alerts, Metrics, Logs, Analytics
limitations: Metrics charts, alert rules, Log Analytics queries and API analytics are not modeled.

azure.apim.scaletier.title: Scale out and up, Pricing tier (post-creation sku.name/sku.capacity over ARM)
limitations: The Consumption (no scale units) and Developer (capped at exactly 1 unit) capacity limits ARE enforced on every PUT/PATCH. Other tiers' maximum unit counts and multi-region/zone scale-out are not — the tier name and unit count you set are stored and reflected in Overview and every other blade exactly as configured.

azure.apim.defender.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud (this API Management service's recommendations)
limitations: Shows the live Defender for Cloud recommendations for this resource from Vyomi's rule engine (see azure.defender.recommendations); Azure's full built-in recommendation catalogue is not reproduced.

azure.apim.deployment.title: Network, Custom domains, Locations, Managed identities (user-assigned), Certificates, Gateways, Self-hosted gateways
limitations: Multi-region deployment, VNet/custom-domain/certificate configuration, and managed/self-hosted gateways are not modeled.

azure.apim.apitags.crud.title: API Tags (Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/tags) — create, get, list, delete
limitations: Associating a tag with a specific API (apiTagResources) is not modeled; this page manages the service-wide tag catalog only, same as named values/backends.

azure.apim.policyfragments.crud.title: Policy fragments (Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/policyFragments) — create, get, list, delete
limitations: Vyomi stores the fragment's XML exactly as configured but never evaluates or injects it into a live request pipeline — Vyomi's gateway does not execute policies.

azure.apim.tools.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Events, MCP Servers, Workspaces, Credential manager, Tasks, Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These portal troubleshooting, catalog and support tools are not modeled.

azure.apim.exporttemplate.title: Export template
limitations: All three tabs (ARM Template, Bicep, Terraform) are generated from the live resource's own known shape, not a general decompiler for arbitrary resources.
